```st
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR_INPUT
    startBtn  : BOOL;
    resetBtn  : BOOL;
    doneSensor: BOOL;
    targetVol : REAL;
    flowVol   : REAL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    valveOpen : BOOL;
    fillsToday: INT;
END_VAR
VAR
    state           : INT;
    prev_startBtn   : BOOL;
    prev_resetBtn   : BOOL;
    prev_valveOpen  : BOOL;
    pendingConfirm  : BOOL;
    accumulatedVol  : REAL;
    rising_startBtn : BOOL;
    rising_resetBtn : BOOL;
END_VAR

rising_startBtn := startBtn AND NOT prev_startBtn;
rising_resetBtn := resetBtn  AND NOT prev_resetBtn;

IF rising_resetBtn THEN
    valveOpen     := FALSE;
    fillsToday    := 0;
    accumulatedVol := 0.0;
    pendingConfirm := FALSE;
    state := 0;
    prev_startBtn  := startBtn;
    prev_resetBtn  := resetBtn;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF rising_startBtn AND (state = 0 OR state = 2) THEN
    accumulatedVol := flowVol;
    state := 1;
    IF accumulatedVol >= targetVol THEN
        valveOpen := FALSE;
        pendingConfirm := TRUE;
    ELSE
        valveOpen := TRUE;
    END_IF;
    prev_startBtn := startBtn;
    prev_resetBtn := resetBtn;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

IF state = 1 THEN
    accumulatedVol := accumulatedVol + flowVol;
    IF accumulatedVol >= targetVol THEN
        valveOpen := FALSE;
        accumulatedVol := targetVol;
        pendingConfirm := TRUE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

IF pendingConfirm AND doneSensor THEN
    fillsToday := fillsToday + 1;
    pendingConfirm := FALSE;
    state := 0;
END_IF;

prev_startBtn := startBtn;
prev_resetBtn := resetBtn;
END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
```
